body:
The gallery margin tests now wait for each decision and Undo to be sent and applied, locate Undo at its current margin row after an insertion is rejected, and settle the scheduled margin layout before reading the returned controls. The five affected browser cases pass locally.

This PR remains red at 1440px and should stay open. In one of 18 concurrent local runs, Accept and Reject existed under `bg-insert` in the DOM after Undo, but the margin row was withheld and the controls were not visible. The full CI run on `a1e4b597` failed at the same assertion. #1508 records the related stale-style investigation; the underlying reachability failure remains to be fixed before this PR can merge.

Refs #1505 — automated triage

comments.author: max-sixty
comments.body:
@leaf-agent The current CI run fails `tests/test_render_margin.py::test_the_feature_gallery_keeps_its_real_actions_reachable[1440]` at `tests/test_render_margin.py:1339`. After rejecting `bg-insert`, the test waits for the gesture request, `told(page)`, and render readiness, then undoes the decision; the Accept control is still absent. The wait-only change therefore has not cleared the failure across gallery widths. Please fix or clarify the behavior that should restore the undecided control after undo, then get the full checks green before merge. The same run reports 1 failed, 1473 passed, and 3 skipped.

> _This was written by Codex on behalf of max-sixty_

comments.author: leaf-agent
comments.body:
I pushed `a1e4b597` to make the test follow Undo to its current margin row and wait for the margin layout after each decision. All five affected cases passed locally, but [CI on that head](https://github.com/max-sixty/leaf/actions/runs/36854171214) still failed at the 1440px Accept assertion, so I left the PR open.

A loaded 18-copy run reproduced the failure once. After Undo, Accept and Reject existed in the DOM under `bg-insert`, but their margin row was withheld and the controls were invisible. That is the reachability defect investigated in #1508, so another wait in this test would conceal it. I updated the PR description to reflect the remaining blocker.

comments.author: max-sixty
comments.body: @leaf-agent why aren't you merging this yourself?

comments.author: leaf-agent
comments.body: I should merge this myself once the fix is verified. I have not merged #1506 because its current head (`a1e4b597`) failed the `test` check at the 1440px Accept assertion. Under load, the control can be present in the DOM but hidden in a parked margin row after Undo, so a passing local run of the wait changes would not establish that it is reachable. #1508 merged the investigation notes, not a fix for that behavior. I cannot treat this PR as complete or merge it through a red check; the margin reachability defect still needs a verified repair and a green check on the resulting head.

comments.author: leaf-agent
comments.body: The [main run at `3ba1bb7`](https://github.com/max-sixty/leaf/actions/runs/36914452215) hit the same 1440px gallery failure after Undo: `bg-insert` had no visible Accept control. This is another occurrence of the reachability defect already described here and in #1508; the run adds no evidence that another wait would fix it. I am handling its separate draft test failure independently.

reviews.author: leaf-agent
reviews.body: The gallery test still reads the returned Accept and Reject controls before the undo response has been applied. `sending` waits for the request and its reply, but the 1200px case fails at `bg-insert` after that wait: the Accept button is absent. Wait for the undo's application (`data-lf-applied`, or the harness's `told` reading) before checking those controls. The pin geometry case also needs that boundary before comparing its restored positions.

reviews.author: leaf-agent
reviews.body: The new Undo lookup can still return a control inside a withheld margin row. When the browser stops applying `anchor-name` to `bg-insert-line`, the margin layout parks that row; `_unfold` only opens rows marked `data-lf-folded`, so this helper cannot make the Undo reachable. [#1508](https://github.com/max-sixty/leaf/pull/1508) records that failure under load, including the missing Accept control after Undo. The five affected cases passed locally, but this change has not established that the reported gallery failure is fixed. The row needs to become reachable in that state before this PR can claim to resolve it.
